scheduler.motion_phase: global cumulative beat phase, never reset on move switch
scheduler.transition: hard switch with no added interpolation or crossfade
scheduler.sampling_difference: Ideal beat-boundary sampling replaces the hardware demo's wall-clock loop jitter and discarded boundary overshoot. Move order, hold beats, global motion phase, exclusions and parameters are unchanged.

adaptation.initial_pose_policy: Subtract the first sampled reordered Euler offset, then add the target neutral. This fixed per-crop translation matches every method's neutral initial joint state; it is not selected from evaluation metrics.
adaptation.axis_meaning: Direct named Euler-coordinate projection: Reachy pitch/roll/yaw offsets become Misty head_pitch/head_roll/head_yaw offsets, positive sign retained. This is not a calibrated cross-robot kinematic transform.
adaptation.arms: If a five-joint head/arms profile is supplied, both arms stay at that profile's neutral. Antennas are never mapped to arms.
adaptation.projection_or_smoothing: none; report original joint-limit violations and switching discontinuities
adaptation.scope: offline commanded trajectory, unverified Misty example limits
